Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5579; veracious:--that cannot lie.
BiblicalUsage: Paul opens his letter to Titus with the hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began. The word is simply that God cannot lie, and the promise rests on it.
TheologicalSignificance: A promise is only as good as the one who makes it, and God cannot lie.
